# Commit Message Convention

## Format

## Types
| Type | When to use |
|------|------------|
| `feat` | New feature or capability |
| `fix` | Bug fix |
| `test` | Adding or updating tests |
| `chore` | Dependencies, config, tooling |
| `docs` | Documentation only |
| `refactor` | Code restructure, no behavior change |
| `perf` | Performance improvement |

## Scopes
| Scope | What it covers |
|-------|---------------|
| `phase1` | Phase 1 local foundation |
| `phase2` | Phase 2 business rules engine |
| `phase3` | Phase 3 GitHub best practices |
| `db` | Database / MySQL changes |
| `agent` | Claude AI agent changes |
| `api` | FastAPI routes / endpoints |
| `schema` | Schema extractor changes |
| `rules` | Business rules changes |
| `prompt` | Prompt builder changes |

## Examples
## Rules
- Subject line max 72 characters
- Use imperative mood: "add" not "added" or "adds"
- No period at end of subject line
- Separate body from subject with blank line
- Reference phases/steps in scope when relevant
